entries.english:
Disputes between Rosenberg and Castell concerning the Vestenberg family.

Term: 1559, 1603–1605.

Contains: 1. fols. 1–104, arrest of Konrad Christoph von Vestenberg by Count Georg von Castell following hunting disputes; Zaisolph von Rosenberg’s attack on Count Konrad von Castell near Kitzingen and his arrest; mediation by Duke Christoph von Württemberg and Margrave Georg Friedrich von Brandenburg-Ansbach, 1559; 2. fols. 105–289, disputes between Count Wolfgang von Castell and the relatives of the deceased Wilhelm von Vestenberg zu Burghaslach, including Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg, concerning guardianship of Vestenberg’s minor son and administration of the Castell fief of Burghaslach, 1603–1605.

Extent: 1 volume, fols. 1–289.
